messages:
Ivy C.: Incoming EU DSAR for full chat + derived embeddings erasure, requester asks for signed proof. ReqID EU-2026-999.

Markus D.: Hosted user. user_id: u999. Map: convo objects in gs://prod/users/u999/, embeddings in vecdb-shard-11, daily snapshots encrypted with platform-key-v6.

Nina (Platform): Important: snapshots archived to cold vault for 180 days then to long-term. Need retention-exception if requester wants removal from archives within 30 days.

Priya L. (Legal): We need manifest of deleted paths, raw audit-line export with operator principal, and operator-signed attestation. Do not rotate KMS keys without legal + customer approval. Request retention-exception for audit logs to 180 days.

Markus D.: Proposed flow: 1) Create ephemeral RBAC role `dsar_u999` TTL=6h scoped to u999. 2) Dry-run to enumerate objects -> produce manifest in gs://compliance/dsar/EU-2026-999/dryrun.json. 3) Canary (single shard). 4) Pause snapshot & backup jobs. 5) Delete derived -> index rows -> raw objects -> snapshots. 6) Run tombstone compaction and replication sweep. 7) Export raw audit-lines, operator signs manifest.

Ivy C.: Add: purge any search caches and CDN caches referencing user content. Verify `SELECT count(*) FROM embeddings WHERE user_id='u999'` = 0 after compaction.

ops-bot: Created ticket DSAR-999. Scheduled canary in 1 hour.

kms-bot: keys: platform-key-v6 (embeddings), snapshot-key-2024. No automatic rotations scheduled.

Priya L. (Legal): Schema approved if each manifest entry includes `request_id`, `scope` (hosted/dedicated), `operator_role`, and `kms_key_id`. Operator statement must include: "to my knowledge and ability, data listed in manifest X has been deleted from Redwood systems as of TIMESTAMP" plus signature.

Markus D.: I'll open RBAC PR and upload dry-run. Canary -> if green we'll pause backups and proceed EOD.

Ivy C.: Thanks team. Keep updates here for blockers only.
